Package neqsim.process.equipment.reservoir

Class RadialDarcyWaterInjectivity

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.reservoir.RadialDarcyWaterInjectivity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RadialDarcyWaterInjectivity extends Object implements Serializable
Stateless radial-Darcy water-injectivity law with explicit PVT evidence.

The model evaluates q = 2 pi k h (p_bh - p_r) / (mu B (ln(r_e / r_w) + S)) and reports the rate at standard conditions in Sm3/day. It contains no fracture, relative-permeability, crossflow, transient-reservoir or calibration model. Those constraints remain with the owning well and reservoir workflow.

1.0
Author:

  • Constructor Details

    • RadialDarcyWaterInjectivity

      private RadialDarcyWaterInjectivity(double permeabilityMd, double thicknessM, double skinFactor, double drainageRadiusM, double wellboreRadiusM, double temperatureK, double configuredViscosityCp, double configuredFormationVolumeFactor, RadialDarcyWaterInjectivity.PvtMode pvtMode)
      Creates an immutable radial-Darcy law.
      Parameters:
      permeabilityMd - formation permeability (mD)
      thicknessM - completed thickness (m)
      skinFactor - dimensionless skin factor
      drainageRadiusM - drainage radius (m)
      wellboreRadiusM - wellbore radius (m)
      temperatureK - reservoir temperature (K), when required
      configuredViscosityCp - configured viscosity (cP), when required
      configuredFormationVolumeFactor - configured reservoir m3/Sm3, when required
      pvtMode - water-property basis
